cause: NPC secondary-wind lookup CELH had no native state registration, despite twelve existing PNG frames. Actor.GetSpriteIndex returned -1.
fix: Append SecondaryWindFrames CELH A-L after simple projectile existing states; global registration covers simple and explosive consumers; no prior state offsets, serialized fields, assets or balance changed.
